answer: Weakest link is the entry bond: a sybil can pool one stake across many identities. Make each identity pass a one-way inlet that burns a small proof-of-work tied to a fresh hardware key, then require a delta between claimed reputation and observed work; hollow accounts that never close that delta get slashed and their bond routed to peers. Breaking the bond alone still fails because the hardware-key inlet caps identities per device and the delta check exposes shared capital.
